query:
The group settled on cooking at home for the Saturday dinner rather than going out. What did Marcus's specific response in that moment signal about his actual preference, and what in how he responded tells you that?

Options:
A. Kevin
B. Marcus
C. Diane
D. Tanya
context:
[1] (about=Diane, episodic, t4 @2026-01-25T14:48:00) Great. So Marcus, Tanya, and me confirmed for the 14th. Kevin we'll keep a seat warm. Now, Saturday dinner. I was thinking we could go somewhere nice in Durham for once, make it a proper outing. Bull Durham Beef isn't too far, or there's a new place on Ninth Street that Tanya mentioned.
[2] (about=Marcus, episodic, t4 @2026-01-25T15:19:00) yeah I'll skip the walk. More time to set up the grill.
[3] (about=Tanya, episodic, t4 @2026-01-25T15:20:00) Marcus always has his priorities sorted 😄 ok so Saturday plan: no fixed alarm, walk when ready, grill goes on by noon, main meal by 2. Does that work for everyone?
[4] (about=Loretta, episodic, t4 @2026-01-25T15:01:00) Fried chicken, collards, macaroni. Marcus can do whatever he wants on that grill in addition. But the main meal is mine.
[5] (about=Loretta, episodic, t7 @2026-02-08T15:20:00) I want everyone to know I am still full from Saturday. Marcus, that chicken was very good. Diane, thank you for driving. Kevin, next time you will be there.
[6] (about=Kevin, episodic, t8 @2026-02-08T15:22:00) grandma I feel that from chicago 😭 glad it was good though. was marcus actually on his grill behavior or did he just stand next to it
[7] (about=Diane, episodic, t10 @2026-02-15T17:40:00) Of course, Mama. That has always been the intention. When we do have that conversation, it will be with you. I'm glad the kitchen is sorted and I'm glad Marcus went up. Love, Diane
[8] (about=Tanya, episodic, t0 @2026-01-11T16:38:00) Uncle Marcus always gets the home-cooked welcome 😄 Meanwhile I drove up in October and got a sandwich from the freezer
[9] (about=Loretta, episodic, t10 @2026-02-15T17:14:00) I'll say this once. I found my medication. Marcus came, the kitchen is in better order now. I did not need an 11pm crisis, I needed someone to come look. There is a difference. Marcus, thank you for coming without making it a production.
[10] (about=Diane, episodic, t14 @2026-03-01T16:30:00) I'm looking forward to hearing it whenever you're ready. Re: Marcus, I called Thursday as discussed. We talked through the April visit and also just generally. I notice he's been more present this month, in a different way.
[11] (about=Marcus, said_by=Loretta, profile, t0 @2026-01-11T16:02:00) Marcus gets a home-cooked meal when he visits, unlike Tanya who got a freezer sandwich.
[12] (about=Marcus, said_by=Kevin, profile, t8 @2026-02-08T15:22:00) Kevin joked about Marcus's grilling behavior, asking if he actually grilled or just stood next to it.
agent_answer:
**B. Marcus**

Marcus’s response signaled that his actual preference was **to cook/grill at home**, not go out for Saturday dinner. What tells you that is his line:

> “yeah I'll skip the walk. More time to set up the grill.”

That shows he was already prioritizing grill prep at home over the group’s earlier idea of going somewhere nice in Durham.

[21] (about=GROUP, said_by=Loretta, group-interaction, t14 @2026-03-01T16:13:00) Settled that no one is moving Loretta out of her house; the family discussion was about having a plan, not making a decision.
[22] (about=GROUP, said_by=Diane, group-interaction, t10 @2026-02-15T16:47:00) Agreed to have a broader conversation about the house and setup eventually, not now and not in front of Loretta.
agent_answer:
The family’s apparent agreement was group-level: **no one is moving Loretta out of her house**, and the discussion was about **having a plan, not making a decision**—with a broader conversation about the house/setup to happen later, **not now and not in front of Loretta**.

Marcus’s brief response, **“handled it,”** suggests he treated the immediate issue as resolved rather than committing to the broader care-planning conversation. So the agreement was **not complete** regarding the longer-term plan.

**Answer: D. Marcus**
